title: weave-record/1 container manifest
description: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 for manifest.json of a weave-record/1 container. This document also carries the shared $defs reused by envelope.json, ref.json and the kind schemas, plus $defs.manifest_attestation for signatures/manifest.sig.json. Rules JSON Schema cannot express are enforced by tools/check_schemas.py and listed in schemas/README.md.

origin.title: origin
origin.description: Project slug plus the publishing instance key id. Shared by the record envelope, references and the manifest.

key_id.title: ed25519 key id
key_id.description: ed25519: followed by the first 32 lowercase hex characters of SHA-256 over the 32-byte raw RFC 8032 public key.

digest.title: digest string
digest.description: sha256: followed by exactly 64 lowercase hex characters. Container positions (records, previous_manifest, chain head, blobs, attestation digest) require sha256 in H0.

timestamp.title: timestamp literal
timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC with exactly three fractional digits and a literal Z, years 0000-9999, seconds 00-59. Calendar validity is not expressible in JSON Schema; see schemas/README.md.

kind_name.title: kind name
kind_name.description: Registered or opaque kind name: dot/dash separated lowercase segments, at most 128 ASCII bytes. The specification additionally requires a project segment; see schemas/README.md.

record_id.title: record id
record_id.description: 1-256 Unicode scalar values, no C0/C1/DEL control characters, no leading or trailing U+0020. Lone surrogates cannot be rejected by JSON Schema; see schemas/README.md.

public_key.title: Ed25519 public key
public_key.description: Unpadded base64url encoding of 32 raw bytes: 43 characters, final character constrained to the alphabet that leaves the two unused bits zero. Structural checks only; point validity and subgroup order are checked when a signature is verified.

signature_value.title: Ed25519 signature value
signature_value.description: Unpadded base64url encoding of a 64-byte Ed25519 signature: 86 characters, final character constrained to the alphabet that leaves the four unused bits zero.

algorithm_name.title: signature algorithm name
algorithm_name.description: Signature algorithm name: a lowercase ASCII token, at most 32 bytes (for example ed25519). Unknown algorithm names are structurally valid; their signature entries are ignored semantically.

generic_key_id.title: generic signature key id
generic_key_id.description: Key id shape accepted for signature algorithms other than ed25519: an algorithm-name token, a colon, and 1-128 lowercase hex characters. Entries with unknown algorithms are structurally valid but semantically ignored.

generic_signature_value.title: generic signature value
generic_signature_value.description: Strict unpadded base64url of 1-2048 bytes for signature algorithms other than ed25519. The three alternatives select the character-count classes congruent to 0, 2 and 3 modulo 4 (the only valid unpadded base64url lengths); the final character of the classes with unused bits is constrained to the zero-unused-bits alphabet.

signature.title: signature entry
signature.description: One per-record or manifest signature with the algorithm-agility condition: alg=ed25519 requires an ed25519 key id and a 64-byte value; other algorithm names accept the generic key id and generic base64url value and are semantically ignored by H0 verifiers. Ordering by key and per-key uniqueness are enforced by tools/check_schemas.py.

signatures.title: signature set
signatures.description: Non-empty array of 1-16 signature entries. Sorted by key ascending with unique keys; enforced by tools/check_schemas.py.

manifest_record.title: manifest record entry
manifest_record.description: One entry of manifest.records. Entries are sorted by digest ascending with unique digests, and their id/kind must equal the listed record file; enforced by tools/check_schemas.py.

previous_manifest.title: previous manifest reference
previous_manifest.description: Digest of the previous container manifest. When non-null, previous/manifest.json must exist, must hash to this digest and must carry the same origin (the origin check is a verifier rule).

chain.title: internal chain head
chain.description: L1/L2 internal hash-chain claim. Offline verification cannot recompute it; a verifier reports it unverified.

blob.title: blob entry
blob.description: One content-addressed blob entry of manifest.blobs. Sorted by digest ascending with unique digests; enforced by tools/check_schemas.py.

timestamp_path.title: timestamp receipt path
timestamp_path.description: Container-relative path of one RFC 3161 timestamp receipt: signatures/timestamp-<n>.tsr with n a decimal integer >= 1.

manifest_timestamp.title: manifest timestamp entry
manifest_timestamp.description: One RFC 3161 timestamp receipt listed by signatures/manifest.sig.json. renews is null for the single chain head and otherwise names the preceding receipt in the re-stamping chain (the chain structure is enforced by tools/check_schemas.py; imprint and CMS verification belong to the verifier). Entries are sorted by path ascending with unique paths.

manifest_attestation.title: manifest signature file
manifest_attestation.description: Shape of signatures/manifest.sig.json. The digest binds the exact manifest.json canonical bytes, never manifest.json itself. timestamps is always present (empty for L0/L1, a single renewal chain for L2); whether the list is compatible with manifest.level is a cross-file rule that JSON Schema cannot express.
